    • enqueue

    • claimNextJob

      @Transactional public Optional<PostureJob> claimNextJob()
      Claims and locks the next eligible job in one transaction: the SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and the immediate status flip to RUNNING happen atomically, so between them no other worker can see this row as still QUEUED. This is the method a scheduled worker calls on every poll tick.

    • markComplete

      @Transactional public void markComplete(UUID jobId)

    • markFailed

      @Transactional public void markFailed(UUID jobId, String errorMessage)
      Marks a job failed. If it still has attempts remaining, requeues it with an exponential-ish backoff (attempt_count minutes, capped at 15) rather than retrying immediately - the same spirit as the Python project's HW_HEALTH_FAILURE_BACKOFF_SECONDS, so a target that's genuinely unreachable doesn't get hammered every poll tick. Once max_attempts is exhausted, the job is left in FAILED for a human to see rather than retried forever.
